LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistMortarPayload.la: make dual mortar payload amplifier module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistMortarPayload.de:
Looks like they just crammed more explosives inside.
Increases the main mortar shell damage by 25% and explosion radius by 50%, retaining the shell type and its original effects. Fits only the dual mortar, in a left, right or top slot. Each type may be installed or queued only once per turret; the payload and support modules can be fitted together. Manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Requires a fixed 100 W. With Combat Extended, the existing CE ammunition system and selected physical shell type are retained. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.

LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistMortarSupport.la: make dual mortar rapid-fire support module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistMortarSupport.de:
We cranked up the voltage on the autoloader!
Reduces aiming time and post-shot cooldown by 25% each. Automatically loads compatible physical shells within 6 cells of the base footprint, without pawn hauling or additional reload work. Forbidden, reserved, carried and shells on other floors (Logical Floors) are excluded. Automatic loading uses real shells and consumes inventory matching the number of rounds loaded. Turning automatic reload off also stops this nearby supply. Fits only the dual mortar, in a left, right or top slot. Each type may be installed or queued only once per turret; the payload and support modules can be fitted together. Manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Requires a fixed 100 W. With Combat Extended, the existing CE ammunition system and selected physical shell type are retained. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
